name: Little sweet Betsy
desc: Little sweet Betsy (Trillium cuneatum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 20 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Trillium cuneatum, the little sweet betsy, also known as whip-poor-will flower, large toadshade, purple toadshade, and bloody butcher, is a species of flowering plant in the family Melanthiaceae.
